title: Premise
text:
Premise
Premise
Definition
The premise is a unit to be supplied that is spatially closed (e.g. apartment, factory hall).
Use
Several utility installations can belong to a premise. Since the premise is division-independent, you can do the following: Allocate electricity and water supply installations to the same premise.
The premise is allocated to a connection object and its address.
You can maintain the following information fields for each premise:
Street supplements allow you to manage additional information about the street name of the connection object. You can also define different street names.
Situation data helps field sales representative to identify the corresponding premise more quickly.
For a premise, you can enter an owner who must pay open bills if the premise is empty (see also
Owner Allocation
).
